standard_prerequisites.name: The local rings at height one primes of a Noetherian normal domain are discrete valuation rings, and the notion of a weakly unramified extension of such rings is the one defined for extensions of discrete valuation rings
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the hypothesis of the statement meaningful and supplies the valuations used in every later step.

standard_prerequisites.name: Primes minimal over one element of a Noetherian domain have height one
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the primes minimal over the function are exactly the height one primes whose valuations the proof computes.

standard_prerequisites.name: An element of a normal domain whose valuation at every height one prime is bounded below by that of another element lies in the multiple of the second element
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: invoked at proof lines 37430-37436 and again at proof lines 37446-37448 and at the end at proof lines 37473-37476
standard_prerequisites.use: Underlies the claim that the extension of the ideal cuts out exactly the elements with the prescribed valuation bounds, and the final comparison of the two generators.

standard_prerequisites.name: A module over the smaller ring which becomes free of rank one after a faithfully flat base change is itself free of rank one
standard_prerequisites.use: Descends the rank one free module property from the larger ring to the smaller one, producing the element whose power differs from the given function by a unit.

core_obligations: Note that the local rings at height one primes are discrete valuation rings so the hypothesis makes sense, and let the primes minimal over f be the height one primes of the smaller ring (proof lines 37401-37407).

List the height one primes of the larger ring over each of them and number them so that the first one gives a weakly unramified extension; from the equality in the larger local ring conclude that the valuation of f at each of the small primes is divisible by n (proof lines 37408-37414).

Define the ideal cut out by the exact sequence with the products of the local quotients by the corresponding powers of the maximal ideals, and tensor it with the larger ring, keeping exactness because the map is flat (proof lines 37415-37422).

Verify the claim that the canonical map from the tensor product of each local quotient to the product of the quotients of the larger local rings is injective: a generator of the principal ideal gives the valuation at each prime above, and an element with the right bound lies in the ideal by the intersection property of normal domains (proof lines 37423-37436).

Combine the claim with the tensored sequence to describe the extended ideal as the elements of the larger ring with the prescribed valuation bounds, and use that the root has exactly those valuations to see that the extended ideal is a free module of rank one generated by the root (proof lines 37437-37467).

Descend freeness of rank one along the faithfully flat map, take a generator of the ideal in the smaller ring, and compare it with the root and with f using the intersection property at height one primes to conclude that the power of the generator differs from f by a unit (proof lines 37468-37477).
proof_roadmap: Set up the height one primes and the divisibility of the valuation of f, and cut out the ideal I by an exact sequence (proof lines 37401-37422).
Prove the injectivity claim describing the tensor product of each local quotient inside the product over the primes above (proof lines 37423-37436).
Identify the extension of I with the elements having the prescribed valuation bounds and conclude that it is free of rank one generated by the root (proof lines 37437-37467).
Descend freeness to the smaller ring, take a generator, and compare it with f to get the unit (proof lines 37468-37477).
difficulty_reason: statement 是「平坦局部 Noether 正规整环之间、在高度 1 素理想处弱非分歧的扩张中，若 f 在 B 中是某个 h 的 n 次幂乘单位，则 f 在 A 中也是某个 g 的 n 次幂乘单位」。证明是一段扎实的估值论证：把 f 的极小素理想（都是高度 1）列出来，用弱非分歧性得到 v_i(f) 被 n 整除；再用局部商构造理想 I 的短正合列；然后要**自己证明一个单射性 claim**——把 (A_p/p^{w})⊗B 映到各 B_q/q^{e·w} 的乘积里是单射，靠正规整环「在每个高度 1 素理想处可除即在环内」的性质；由此把 I⊗B 认成由 h 生成的秩 1 自由模，沿忠实平坦下降回 A 得到 g，最后再用同一性质把 g^n 与 f 的差写成单位。承重演算全在 span 内；5 处引用里 1 处同章定义（使 statement 有意义）、4 处跨章，均为导航桩。
